scope: Production diagnostic source, both standalone tests, documentation; no full installation acceptance
method: Independent comparison of instrumented call order and original source, synchronization/lifecycle analysis, GCC compilation/execution, final documentation check
findings: Original player, terrain, callback and completion call order is retained. Existing post-load capture hooks remain intact. Worker metrics are thread-local and final snapshots are copied under the job mutex. No telemetry mutex is held across reporter calls or logging. Nested sessions restore their parent; timers retain the correct metrics pointer and avoid recursive same-stage double counting. Original Reporter::wait is unchanged; measured wait preserves lock ownership, callback order, progress-only wakeups and exception propagation. workMs ends before Reporter::complete. Wall-time stages overlap; queue latency includes enqueue overhead; waitRequested does not guarantee blocking. Instrumentation runs for every terrain-preload job. Out-of-session timers perform no clock reads/mutex operations. Documentation now specifies early engine frames after save-load returns, no scene-presentation detection, no ordinary-transition rearm, and observing post-load frames before the door transition.
